close: Cross. Filled is the same strokes.
open_in_full: Two corner arrowheads joined by a diagonal: expand.
close_fullscreen: Arrowheads pointing in to the centre: collapse.
star: Five-point star. Line = not favourite, filled = favourite.
edit: Pencil at 45°, tip bottom-left, ferrule line.
list: Three bullets and lines. Active state is the colour role.
bar_chart: Three bars in a rounded frame. Filled: solid frame, bars cut out.
format_list_numbered: Stepper: three linked step circles beside three lines (steps taken). Digits are illegible at 24px, so no numerals.
move_in: Arrow entering a doorway (move into an enclosure).
male: Male symbol ♂: ring with a 45° arrow. Filled keeps the ring (a solid ball reads as a pin).
family_history: Female symbol ♀ (the old icon "add_parent" is a ♀). Filled keeps the ring, like male.
mortality: Skull: cranium, two eyes, jaw split.
account_tree: Hierarchy: one parent box branching to two child boxes (taxonomy tree).
assignment_turned_in: Clipboard (shared base) with a check: action taken.
arrow_shape_up_stack: Arrow-shape pointing up with a chevron stacked above (move up, in bulk).
beenhere: Pointed badge (marker) with a check: tagged / saved.
hard_drive: Drive box with a slanted top and an LED: records storage.
health_and_safety: Shield with a plus: health assessment.
enclosure: Picket fence: three pointed posts and two rails (enclosure / housing).
person_search: Person (shared head-and-shoulders base, small) with a magnifier: found by.
travel_explore: Globe with a magnifier: search public tags.
tag_public: Tag with a globe badge: public tag.
tag_private: Tag with a padlock badge: private tag.
moved_location: Location pin (Eggs pilot geometry) with an arrow badge: moved location.
repro_oviparous: Empty egg: lays eggs (same geometry as the base egg).
repro_ovoviviparous: Egg with an embryo inside: eggs hatch inside the mother.
repro_viviparous: Curled fetus, no shell: live birth (same fetus as fetal_death).
repro_unknown: Egg with a question mark: reproduction mode unknown.
ear_tag_high_left: Ear (rim bulging left) with a ring tag at the top of the rim.
ear_tag_high_right: Ear (rim bulging right) with a ring tag at the top of the rim.
ear_tag_moderate_left: Ear (rim bulging left) with a ring tag at the middle of the rim.
ear_tag_moderate_right: Ear (rim bulging right) with a ring tag at the middle of the rim.
ear_tag_low_left: Ear (rim bulging left) with a ring tag on the lobe.
ear_tag_low_right: Ear (rim bulging right) with a ring tag on the lobe.
dietitian: Apple with stem and leaf: nutrition / dietitian.
compost: Leaf inside a circular arrow: food waste turned to compost (wastage count).
